text:
anya: Heads up — triaging bring-up for pinwheel-v2 (8-bit PQ, per-tensor) on qa_holdout. Seeing recall@1 drop ~7% vs v1 float32. Sharing quick numbers and config.

mike: Can you paste the eval command and raw numbers?

anya: Ran batch eval.
```
python eval.py --model pinwheel-v2 --quant pq8 --dataset qa_holdout --k 10 --metric recall@1
# results: recall@1=0.63, recall@5=0.82, recall@10=0.88
# baseline pinwheel-v1 float32: recall@1=0.70, recall@5=0.84, recall@10=0.89
```

liam: Hmm 7% at R@1 is material. What's the ANN index settings? probe/ef/search params?

anya: Using HNSW with ef_search=64 and PQ probe=16 (our new default for PQ). If I increase probe to 64 R@1 moves to 0.68.

sara: Did you check embedding norms / collapse after quant? PQ can shrink magnitudes.

anya: Yep — norm histogram shows a mode around 0.04 post-quant, baseline had mode ~0.12. Means many vectors cluster near origin.

mike: That explains nearest neighbor ties. Can we try per-channel scales (per-channel PQ) vs per-tensor?

anya: Quick test: per-channel PQ reduces R@1 drop to ~3% (0.68 -> 0.69). Still not perfect.

liam: Also try re-running with L2-normalization before quant and adjusting scaler. Might help.

anya: Ran L2 before PQ -> R@1=0.69, silhouette score for kmeans drops from 0.42 -> 0.30 after default PQ, but per-channel PQ + L2 gets 0.38.

sara: Can you attach a UMAP snapshot? even rough helps.

anya: Posting small UMAP desc: clusters blur for tail classes, main clusters mostly preserved but inter-cluster distances shrink.

eval-bot: [automated] rerun complete: pinwheel-v2 pq8 probe=64 per-channel L2norm -> recall@1=0.695, recall@5=0.835

mike: Ok. Action items: (1) sweep PQ per-channel vs per-tensor + L2 baseline, (2) re-evaluate ANN probe/ef tradeoff, (3) add norm-preserving quant heuristic to quantizer. @liam can you run the sweep today? @sara can you make a quick UMAP comparison script for onboarding docs?

liam: On it — will push sweep and post results in this thread.

sara: I'll draft the UMAP script and add to embed-onboard checklist.

anya: thanks — rolling canary back to float32 for prod traffic for now :thumbsup:
